body.p: Once there lived a girl, she was an orphan. And two girls went to her [literally: to them]. This girl sewed herself a dress made of leaves, a leaf dress. The other two girls â made of calico; good dresses are made of the best calico. Every day the two girls went [to her]. No matter what fabric they choose, this girl has the better dress made of leaves. And so they went and went and went [to her]. Then they came to her and the girl was dead. "What now? Where will we go now? Let's take a knife and stab ourselves![StN]: 1SG?[StN]: mÉl? One of them stabbed herself, then the other one. They felt sorry for this girl. Then they were with this girl in the yurt. They did not know that they were now dead.[StN]: 1PL! "Let's go home!" they say to each other. They ran to their homes. When they got home, they called out to [StN]: go-PASS?their mother, "Mum, [we] are hungry!" The mother hears nothing. "Mum, [we] are hungry!" they shouted loudly. The mother says, "My ears are ringing: The children have come! They ask for food!"[StN]: strange REFL -r
